entries.15918193fd2f464b: A company that develops, manufactures and sells printers and ink, projectors, industrial robots, watches, crystal devices, semiconductors and more.
entries.26f8e1646b526349: The business handles a wide range of products, from industrial robots, watches, components such as crystal devices and semiconductors, metal powders, and PCs for factories to items worn on the body. It consists of four businesses: the Manufacturing Solutions Business, the Wearable Devices Business, the Microdevices and Other Business, and the PC Business, and provides products, development, manufacturing, sales and related services. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥196,868 million (¥172,210 million in the prior year), the second largest business after the Printing Solutions Business. The company explains that segment revenue increased because the Manufacturing Solutions Business grew on higher demand in China and Southeast Asia, the Wearable Devices Business grew on higher sales from inbound demand in Japan and the effect of new product launches, and crystal devices and semiconductors in the Microdevices Business each also recorded higher revenue.
entries.37855fae50158620: The business sells commercial and industrial inkjet printers, printheads, POS system-related products, label printers and digital print software solutions. Fiery, LLC is cited as a major related company. The company explains that revenue increased in the finished-product business for commercial and industrial inkjet printers due to order wins and new product launches, while external sales of printheads remained roughly flat from the prior year, as weak demand in the Chinese market continued. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company recorded an impairment loss on goodwill related to Fiery, and explains that this was because the market environment deteriorated more than expected, as capital investment restraint advanced in the commercial printing and industrial printing markets, due in part to the effects of U.S. tariff policy. The filing does not state the amount for this area alone.
entries.3a4ff219a4929a9f: The business handles various devices featuring compact size, high precision and low power consumption, and also develops and manufactures devices required by each business within the group. Crystal devices, including crystal resonators, crystal oscillators and crystal sensors, are supplied for consumer, automotive and industrial equipment, and are mainly manufactured by Miyazaki Epson Corporation. Semiconductors, including CMOS LSIs, are supplied for consumer and automotive applications, and are manufactured by Tohoku Epson Corporation and Singapore Epson Industrial Pte. Ltd. In addition, Epson Atmix Corporation and others handle the development, manufacture and sale of high-performance metal powders used as raw materials for electronic components, and high value-added surface treatment processing for a wide range of industrial fields. The company explains that crystal devices recorded a substantial increase in revenue amid continued growth in sales, and semiconductors recorded higher revenue as demand recovered among some customers. The filing does not state the amount for this business alone.
entries.6524af4db2a87a4e: The business makes and sells LCD projectors and smart glasses. Leveraging proprietary microdisplay and projection technologies, it develops, manufactures and sells products for business, education, home and event use, and provides related services. The main related companies for manufacturing are Epson Engineering (Shenzhen) Ltd. and Epson Precision (Philippines), Inc.; sales are conducted in Japan by Epson Sales Japan Corporation and overseas by sales companies in the United States, Brazil, Europe, the Middle East, China, Asia, Oceania, India and other regions. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥181,388 million (¥203,782 million in the prior year), a decrease of 11.0% year on year. The company explains that the deterioration in the Chinese market, together with lower sales in the education market, mainly in Europe and the United States, had a significant impact.
entries.8fe35470e66d9189: The business sells PCs and other products in the domestic market through subsidiaries. No main related company for manufacturing is listed; the main related companies for sales are Epson Sales Japan Corporation and Epson Direct Corporation. The filing does not state the amount for this business alone.
entries.9e0f97d8073b2648: The business sells printers for offices and homes, along with their ink and other consumables. Products are manufactured by Tohoku Epson Corporation, Akita Epson Corporation, and manufacturing companies in the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Italy, China, Indonesia, the Philippines and other countries; sales are conducted in Japan by Epson Sales Japan Corporation and overseas by sales companies in the United States, Europe, China, Asia, Oceania, India and other regions. The company explains that sales of office and home inkjet printer units were firm, resulting in slightly higher revenue. For high-capacity ink tank models, unit sales increased mainly in emerging markets in the Middle East and Africa, as well as in Asia and South America, while ink cartridge sales declined, and revenue from consumables was roughly flat from the prior year. The filing does not state the amount for this area alone.
entries.af0006ede36b2f7c: The business makes and sells printers and consumables such as ink. It has two business areas, office and home, and commercial and industrial, and provides products, development, manufacturing, sales and related services, leveraging strengths such as its proprietary micro piezo technology and dry fiber technology. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,029,483 million (¥980,078 million in the prior year), the largest of the three reportable segments and accounting for most of consolidated revenue of ¥1,413,251 million. The company explains that revenue increased in both office and home and commercial and industrial, and segment revenue rose 5.0% year on year.
entries.fdf1ef21e55622c7: The business leverages ultra-fine and ultra-precision processing technology, high-density packaging technology and high-precision sensing technology to make and sell watches and watch movements. The main related companies for manufacturing are Akita Epson Corporation, Epson Precision (Thailand) Ltd. and Epson Precision (Johor) Sdn. Bhd.; sales are conducted by Epson Sales Japan Corporation, Epson Europe B.V., Epson (China) Co., Ltd. and Epson Hong Kong Ltd. The company explains that revenue increased, reflecting higher sales driven by inbound demand in Japan and the effect of new product launches. The filing does not state the amount for this business alone.
entries.ffc405b5e4acb840: The business leverages advanced precision mechatronics, high-precision sensing and software technologies to make and sell industrial robots and other products that innovate productivity. The main related company for manufacturing is Epson Engineering (Shenzhen) Ltd., and sales are conducted in Japan by Epson Sales Japan Corporation and overseas by sales companies in the United States, Germany, Italy, China, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan and other regions. The company explains that revenue increased as demand expanded in China and Southeast Asia, while the recovery in the markets of its main sales regions was slower than expected and uncertainty remained over the investment trends of some major customers, and therefore it recorded an impairment loss. The filing does not state the amount for this business alone.
